## ⚠️ BREAKING CHANGE: Z-Wave connection method has changed — action required after updating.

This release moves all devices with a Z-Wave radio from the raw TCP serial stream to the native **ESPHome Z-Wave Proxy**. A recent zwave-js change breaks reconnection over serial-over-TCP streams (https://github.com/zwave-js/zwave-js/pull/8861)  I encountered this when attempting to update firmware on some new devices. 

The [Z-Wave Proxy component](https://esphome.io/components/zwave_proxy/) has been out since the 2025.10.0 ESPHome Release. I have been using it on a dual radio configuration - alongside a MG24 radio flashed with RCP firmware for my Thread network - with no issues since that release.

**After installing this update, the Z-Wave TCP serial port is removed** ( on Z-Wave-only devices,  on dual-radio devices). Z-Wave JS will not reconnect until you update its connection settings.

### What you need to do after updating

- **Z-Wave JS UI (standalone / Docker):** Settings → Z-Wave → Serial Port — replace  (or  on dual-radio) with the ESPHome connection: .
- **Home Assistant Z-Wave JS add-on:** the device is now advertised as an ESPHome Z-Wave adapter and will be offered via discovery; select it in place of the old TCP path.

📖 Step-by-step instructions with screenshots: https://tube0013.github.io/tube_gateways/getting-started/z-wave-proxy-update/

**Zigbee is unaffected** — the Zigbee serial stream on dual-radio devices (port 6638) is unchanged, and no Zigbee2MQTT/ZHA changes are needed.

### Devices in this release (firmware 2026.07.11.0)

- tubeszb-zw
- tubeszb-2026-zw
- tubeszb-dual-radio-kit-cc2652
- tubeszb-dual-radio-kit-mgm24
- tubeszb-dual-radio-mgm21-2022

Devices running  firmware (already on the Z-Wave proxy) receive this update as well; it moves them onto the standard release track, and they will follow regular releases from the next version onward.

### Other changes

- Dual-radio cc2652 kit: Zigbee UART  raised to 1024 to match the standalone cc2652 devices.
- Dual-radio mgm24 kit: adopts the boot-probe and UI refinements from the experimental build.
- All other (non-Z-Wave) devices are **not** rebuilt by this release and will not see an update.
